caption: The drawing depicts an ornately decorated interior scene with a combination of furniture and decorative elements. Red wallpaper with gold floral patterns borders the walls, while a large section of the back wall opens onto a space with a blue monochrome depiction of trees and buildings, possibly painted or as a backdrop. In the left foreground, there is a wooden high-backed chair with a carved top, next to a low, round table covered with a gold and red patterned tablecloth holding various small objects, including an umbrella and a fan. Behind the table is a wicker seat with an arched back, decorated with a garland of red and pink flowers and holding a large fan and textiles. An umbrella lies on the floor beside a corner of a green rug. To the right, there is a wooden side table filled with books, a glass container, and a yellow bird perched atop a box camera. Beside it is a large, ornate wicker chair with circular design elements, positioned on a grey fur rug. A heavy yellow-green curtain is tied to a column, partially obscuring a wall that features a black and white drawing or photograph of a lion's head. The floor is made of medium brown wood, and a light hits the room from the upper left, possibly through the large, multi-paned window visible on the left wall and a skylight in the ceiling. The entire scene is detailed with a variety of textures and patterns, and multiple objects are arranged throughout, giving the space a sense of depth and complexity.
title: Photographer's Studio
